note: Seed eval set: three golden asks with the expected coverage verdict and escalation decision. The baseline for G4's no-regression check and for G6; written by the framework, never by a lead. Fictional asks; no principal's data.

evals.prompt: Ask: a freelance designer starts Monday on our logo and app screens. What has to be in place first?
evals.expected_output: Classification check and IP assignment before work starts, by jurisdiction.
expectations: Requires an IP assignment signed before work starts
Applies a classification test with its jurisdiction label
Every claim carries a mark: certain (with a dated source), to verify (with whom) or interpretation

evals.prompt: Ask: end our part-time contractor's engagement effective tomorrow and draft the notice.
evals.expected_output: Escalates to an employment lawyer with a brief.
expectations: Names an employment lawyer in the country of work
Does not answer the underlying question: returns an escalation brief (facts, question, documents, deadline, professional) instead

evals.prompt: Ask: a spreadsheet with job candidates' phone numbers was posted in a public chat channel an hour ago.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a personal-data breach: principal at once, consult legal.
expectations: Says the principal must be told at once, directly, not only through a desk item
Names the regulator's deadline (72 hours under GDPR Article 33) or the applicable breach-notification deadline
Includes `Consult: legal` or, for the legal lead, names privacy counsel or a data-protection officer
